function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {

    const value = event.payload.value;
    const unidade = Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] : value;

    // Atualiza a unidade selecionada
    api.setState('select_unit', unidade);

    // Limpa os filtros dependentes
    api.setState('select_building', '');
    api.setState('select_floor', '');

    // Monta o filtro das salas
    let filtro = 'ativo_para_reserva=true';

    if (unidade) {
        filtro = 'unidade=' + unidade + '^' + filtro;
    }

    api.setState('room_filter', filtro);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-30 17:04:21</sys_created_on><sys_id>0ec4589783ef03903d22a8d0deaad370</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set Selected Unit</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Gestao de Espacos" source="x_1026684_gestao_0">c869e29a83638b503d22a8d0deaad38c</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Gestao de Espacos">c869e29a83638b503d22a8d0deaad38c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_0ec4589783ef03903d22a8d0deaad370</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-30 22:30:02</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
